notes: Quarter-only figures use exact periods of 65–110 days.
When no quarter-only fact is available, cumulative totals are subtracted only within the same fiscal start and tag. Q4 may be annual total minus nine months.
Latest eligible facts are preferred. Derived values may combine different filings; restatements can affect comparability.
At an annual boundary, TTM sums are checked against matching reported annual totals when available. Disagreeing metrics are withheld.
Trailing 12 months (TTM) requires four consecutive quarters covering 330–380 days. Any metric with missing quarters remains unavailable.
Same-quarter comparison uses a comparable duration ending approximately one year earlier, allowing 52/53-week fiscal calendars.
Annual values use 330–380 day periods; metrics must match the revenue period exactly.
Latest eligible filing for each metric is used; comparative figures may be restated. Different metrics may cite different filings.
The company-facts feed omits segment dimensions. Separate annual-filing enrichment is shown when available; operating KPI coverage varies.
Annual figures anchor valuation; quarterly and trailing results are shown separately. Consensus forecasts are not included.
